## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

## Issue

Closes #... or Refs #... (replace with actual issue numbers).

For an automatically selected batch, list each issue, why they fit one PR and whether its acceptance criteria are fully met. If fewer than two were selected, explain the exception under the development workflow's batching rules.

## Validation

List tests/manual checks performed, results and any untested platforms.

For UI changes, summarize affected-state results and link evidence from [UI acceptance](../docs/DEVELOPMENT.md#ui-acceptance), including specific checks not performed.

## Developer inspection

Confirm PR changes are present in `F:/Magic The Deckbuilder`; identify local-only differences affecting review. Give short inspection steps at `http://localhost:3000/` and say whether refresh or CMD server restart is needed. For documentation-only work, link documents to review.

Ready for inspection does not authorize merging. Record developer approval of current changes before merging; revisions need renewed inspection.

## Tracking

- [ ] Feature inventory updated if capabilities or limitations changed.
- [ ] Changelog updated for completed user-facing changes.
- [ ] Roadmap/issue links updated where relevant; outstanding work remains open.
